levels.name: Diagnostic Integrity
levels.purpose: Validate the LevelUpDiag-Koali frame before trusting target evidence.

levels.name: Environment
levels.purpose: Verify the kOA-Linux target path and the complete core build toolchain (Python/uv/Git/Rust/Cargo/native linker) before subsystem integration.

levels.name: Repository / Structure
levels.purpose: Observe repository and Git context. Advisory in DEBUG; conformance evidence in VALIDATION/RELEASE.

levels.name: Documentation
levels.purpose: Run the configured kOA-Linux documentation validation without gating functional debug.

levels.name: Contracts
levels.purpose: Run the public kOA-Linux contracts validation independently of repository cleanliness formalities.

levels.name: Components
levels.purpose: Run the public kOA-Linux component validations.

levels.name: Integrations
levels.purpose: Run public kOA-Linux integration validations when explicitly selected and, when configured, diagnose standalone/integrated product UI modularity without making optional products core prerequisites.

levels.name: Profiles
levels.purpose: Run the kOA-Linux profile pytest suite through uv with the frozen environment.

levels.name: Security Runtime
levels.purpose: Run the configured kOA-Linux security validation; unavailable prerequisites remain local to this level in DEBUG.

levels.name: Offline Runtime
levels.purpose: Run the configured kOA-Linux offline validation; unavailable prerequisites remain local to this level in DEBUG.

levels.name: System Runtime
levels.purpose: Run the configured kOA-Linux system validation; unavailable prerequisites remain local to this level in DEBUG.

levels.name: Delivery
levels.purpose: Verify that LevelUpDiag-Koali is absent from a configured delivery target.

stabilization.description: Primary Koali core stabilization: diagnostic integrity, environment, contracts and native components only. External subsystems are intentionally deferred.

stabilization-runtime.description: Exploratory core runtime qualification after an image exists. External subsystem closure is not a prerequisite for running these diagnostics, but kOA validators may still report final-profile blockers.

debug.description: Primary non-blocking functional/runtime diagnosis. Repository/documentation formalities are not selected.

structure.description: Repository structure and documentation conformance checks.

validation.description: Run the complete non-release validation sequence.

release.description: Strict full sequence including tracked-state protection and delivery inspection.

preflight.description: Compatibility alias: diagnostic integrity, environment, and repository context.

core.description: Compatibility alias: validation sequence through Components.

standard.description: Compatibility alias for the historical N00-N10 validation campaign.

delivery.description: Strict delivery inspection with release policy.

full.description: Compatibility alias for strict release/finalization N00-N11.

developer-fast.description: Compatibility alias for Koali core stabilization.

bundle-validation.description: Compatibility alias for pre-subsystem build stabilization.

nightly.description: Compatibility alias for full non-release validation.

release-preparation.description: Compatibility alias for strict release preparation.

delivery-check.description: Compatibility alias for strict delivery inspection.

koali_core_pre_subsystem.purpose: Stabilize Koali environment/contracts/native components before integrating independent subsystems.

full_target.purpose: Evaluate the canonical target including required independent subsystems.
